title: 韩语发票信息提取OCR模型开发
summary: 该研究提出一种结合深度学习与图像预处理技术的OCR模型，用于从韩语发票中自动提取关键信息。在收集的发票数据集上评估，模型达到87%的F1分数，且处理时间可忽略不计。
summary_en: This study proposes an efficient OCR model combining deep learning with image preprocessing techniques to automatically extract key information from Korean-language invoices. Evaluated on a rich set of collected invoices, the model achieves 87% F1-score with negligible processing time.
